title: pyrus × scheideckeri
intro: Pyrus × scheideckeri, commonly known as Scheidecker's pear, is a hybrid plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving stress, improving sleep, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus × scheideckeri are attributed to its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it effective in treating anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
